question: The venue of the 1948 Olympic Games was ________ .
solution:
The correct answer is __**London**__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **The London 1948 Olympic Games **were a sporting event held in London from 29 July to August 14,1948.
 
• The London Olympics was the 11th modern Olympics.
 
• The 1948 Olympics proved very popular and appeared to reduce stress caused by war.
 
• Over 4,000+ athletes from 59 countries participated in this game.
 
• Poor weather and poor running conditions resulted in track and field events that saw some of the lowest records in Olympic history.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• The Olympic flag has a white background, with five interlaced rings in the centre: blue, yellow, black, green, and red.
 
 
• Each colour corresponds to a particular continent: blue for Europe, yellow for Asia, black for Africa, green for Australia and Oceania, and red for the Americas.
 
 
 
• The Olympic motto “Citius, Altius, Fortius” (“Faster, Higher, Stronger”) was coined by Father Henri Didon.
 
• Only three modern Olympic Games have been cancelled.
 
 
• The games were cancelled due to World War I (1916) and World War II (1940, 1944).
 
 
 
• The youngest Olympian is Greek gymnast Dimitrios Loundras, who competed in the 1896 Athens Olympics at the age of 10.

Olympic logo: 

 
• It consists of five rings and one icon of the place where it is held
 
• Blue, yellow, black, green, and red is the order of the color of the Olympic logo rings 
 
• It represents five continents: Asia, Africa, America, Australia, and Europe.

Thus, the number of rings in the Olympic flag is 5.__
